password.title: Change password
password.forced: Your password is a one-time password. Set a new one to continue.

policy.common: This password is too common; choose another one.
policy.same_as_username: The password must not be your username.

landing.headline: Multi-agent stock analysis
landing.description: Analyst agents read the market, news, sentiment and fundamentals, then a team of researchers and traders debates and reaches a rating. Here is a preview of the latest analyses shared with visitors.
landing.lockedHint: Log in to read the full analysis
landing.empty: No analyses are shared with visitors yet.

preview.callToActionText: Log in to read every section of this analysis, the debates and the final decision.

dashboard.noActive: No analysis is running right now.

runs.title: Analyses
runs.emptyShared: Nobody has shared an analysis yet.
runs.compareHint: Tick two to four runs to compare them side by side.

compare.title: Compare runs
compare.empty: Pick at least two runs on the Analyses page to compare them.
compare.loadError: This run could not be loaded.

form.title: New analysis
form.customModelHint: You can type a model id that is not listed
form.outputLanguageNote: Agents debate internally in English; reports and the decision are written in this language.
form.catalogUnavailable: Could not load the model list. Is ta-runner installed?
form.noKeyHint: This provider needs its key ({env}) set.

detail.publicConfirm: Everyone on the platform will see this analysis.
detail.partialConfirm: Anyone on the internet will see the preview of this analysis.
detail.notCompletedNote: Only a completed analysis can change its visibility
detail.visibilityConflict: The analysis was changed in the meantime and has been reloaded.
detail.importedNote: This analysis ran outside the platform (e.g. with the CLI) and was imported from the data dir: there is no live event log, the reports are read from its files.
detail.reportLanguageNote: Reports are written in the language the analysis was started with; switching the UI language does not translate them.

prices.title: {ticker} price
prices.source: Source: TradingAgents' price cache (yfinance, daily). Averages are computed the way the market analyst computes them.

settings.title: Settings
settings.keysNote: Keys are stored in the platform's own file (readable by its owner only) and handed to analyses as environment variables. Values are never shown back.

analysisDefaults.title: Analysis defaults
analysisDefaults.note: The provider, models and debate rounds every analysis uses. Only users who may override models can change them for a single analysis.

presets.label: Preset

presets.emptyHint: No presets yet. Save one from the New Analysis page.

reports.latestOnly: {count} analyses ran this ticker and date; the files hold the newest one's report.
